# Sirach Chapter 24 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 24 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

*[WISDOM'S SELF-PRAISE — the theological heart of Sirach, and one of the most important passages in all of Jewish wisdom literature. Wisdom speaks in the heavenly assembly; she recounts her cosmic origin and universal presence; she is then identified with the Torah of Moses. This chapter shaped John's Prologue (John 1:1-18), Paul's Christology (Col 1:15-20), and the Letter to the Hebrews. It is rendered here with the gravity it deserves.]*

**24:1** Wisdom sings her own praise; she glorifies herself in the midst of her people.

**24:2** She opens her mouth in the assembly of the Most High; she boasts of herself before his heavenly host:

**24:3** "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High; I covered the earth like a mist.

**24:4** I dwelt in the heights; my throne was a pillar of cloud.

**24:5** Alone I walked the whole vault of heaven; I traversed the depths of the abyss.

**24:6** I held sway over the waves of the sea, over all the earth, over every people and nation.

**24:7** Among all of these I searched for a resting place — somewhere I could make my home.

**24:8** Then the Creator of all gave me his command; the One who made me found a resting place for my tent, and said: 'Make your home in Jacob; let Israel be your inheritance.'

**24:9** From eternity, before the beginning, he created me; and to eternity I shall not cease.

**24:10** I served in the holy tent before him; in Zion I was established.

**24:11** In the city he loves he gave me rest as well; in Jerusalem I held authority.

**24:12** I took root among a people he had honored — in the LORD's own portion, his inheritance.

**24:13** I grew tall like a cedar in Lebanon, like a cypress on the peaks of Hermon.

**24:14** Like a palm tree in En-gedi I towered up; like rose-bushes in Jericho; like a fine olive tree on the plain; like a plane tree reaching toward the sky.

**24:15** Like cinnamon and fragrant aspalathos I gave my perfume; like the finest myrrh I breathed sweet fragrance — like galbanum and onycha and stacte, like frankincense smoke rising from the tent.

**24:16** Like a terebinth I spread wide my branches — branches full of glory and grace.

**24:17** Like a vine I put out graceful shoots, and my blossoms become fruit: rich with glory and abundance.

**24:19** Come to me, all you who long for me, and eat your fill of my fruit.

**24:20** Thinking of me is sweeter than honey; possessing me is sweeter than the honeycomb.

**24:21** Those who eat me will be hungry for more; those who drink me will thirst for more.

**24:22** Whoever obeys me will never be put to shame; whoever works through me will never go wrong."

**24:23** All this — all of it — is the book of the covenant of the Most High God: the Torah that Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob.

**24:24** [It overflows with wisdom like the Pishon, like the Tigris when the first fruits ripen.]

**24:25** It fills the mind with understanding like the Euphrates, like the Jordan in harvest season.

**24:26** It makes instruction flash like light — like the Gehon in the days of the grape harvest.

**24:27** The first to know her never finished knowing her; the last to search has not found the end of her ways.

**24:28** For she is as vast in her thinking as the sea, as deep in her counsel as the great abyss.

**24:29** As for me — I am like a canal cut from a great river; like an irrigation channel flowing out into a garden.

**24:30** I said, "I will water my garden; I will flood my garden beds." And then my channel became a river; my river became a sea.

**24:31** I will make instruction blaze like morning light again, and send its gleam to the farthest reaches.

**24:32** I will pour out teaching once more like prophecy, and leave it as a gift for every generation to come.

**24:33** Know this: I have not labored for myself alone — but for all who seek wisdom.

**24:34** [I have not labored for myself alone — but for all who seek her.]
